# Fonts

`NotoSans-Regular.ttf`: Noto Sans, hinted TTF, from
https://github.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/tree/main/fonts/NotoSans/hinted/ttf.
Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `NotoSans-OFL.txt`. Covers Latin, Greek and Cyrillic, which
is what track titles mostly need.

The SDL player copies it next to its binary (`fonts/`) at build time.
